_meta.description: Golden image observations for the 20 demo images. They serve as reference labels for evaluating the vision extraction step (Sonnet vision) and Jev's image questions. At runtime these fields are produced by the models; this file is what a careful human adjuster would record.
_meta.confidence_note: Confidences are the annotator's per-element certainty (0-1). They are reference labels, not measured model probabilities.

room_type_cues: sink waste trap typical of a kitchen or bathroom vanity; background is an out-of-focus cabinet or wall

issues: shallow depth of field; background not assessable

damage_present.note: Shows an active leak (the source), not damage to surrounding materials

damage_types.location: brown spots and grime on the pipe

damaged_parts.condition: leaking at the bottom of the bend

severity.note: Leak is visible but no consequential damage is in frame

cues: active drip suggests a current leak
grime and brown spots on the pipe could mean it has been leaking for some time
no mould or rot visible; discoloration on the pipe only

regional_indicators: US-style PVC trap with slip nuts (also common in NL)

summary.en: Close-up of a white plastic sink trap with water dripping from the bend. It shows where the leak comes from, but not the damage it caused.
summary.nl: Close-up van een witte kunststof sifon die lekt aan de onderkant van de bocht. Toont de bron van het lek, niet de gevolgschade.

warnings.message: Image shows the leak source only; cabinet or floor damage is not visible.
Repairing the trap itself is usually excluded; only the resulting damage is covered.

room_type_cues: only a white ceiling surface is in frame

damage_types.location: yellow-brown stains on the exposed surface

damaged_parts.condition: lifted and peeling in large flakes
stained; no visible sagging or hole

cues: brown staining can also come from repeated wetting
no mould spots or rot visible

summary.en: Ceiling with a large area of peeling paint and yellow-brown water stains. This fits water coming through from above. The ceiling has not collapsed.
summary.nl: Plafond met een groot gebied afbladderende verf en geelbruine watervlekken; past bij water van bovenaf. Geen doorzakking zichtbaar.

warnings.message: Only ceiling visible; room cannot be confirmed from the image.

room_type_cues: ceiling-to-wall junction only

damage_types.location: streaky brown stain on textured ceiling near the wall

cues: streaky stains could be one leak or several

regional_indicators: knockdown-textured ceiling is uncommon in NL homes

summary.en: Textured ceiling with a brown water stain and a small crack at the joint with the wall. Minor damage, limited to the surface.
summary.nl: Gestructureerd plafond met een bruine watervlek en een kleine scheur bij de aansluiting op de wand. Lichte, oppervlakkige schade.

room_type_cues: glass museum display cases with artefacts and labels
plinths
commercial dehumidifiers

damage_types.location: wooden strip floor lifted in a ridge across the room

cues: drying equipment is running, so this looks like a recent incident being dried out

mitigation_visible.detail: two dehumidifiers/air movers at the back of the room

visible_text: exhibit label text (German, illegible at this size)

summary.en: A wooden strip floor has buckled and lifted in a ridge, which is typical water swelling, and drying equipment is running. The room is a museum exhibition space, not a home.
summary.nl: Houten vloer opgebold door vocht, met droogapparatuur in bedrijf. De ruimte is een museumzaal met vitrines, geen woning.

warnings.message: Display cases and exhibits indicate a museum, not a private home.
Professional composition of a public building; check reverse image search / hash history.

room_type_cues: upper kitchen cabinets
range hood
plumbing for sink

damage_types.location: drywall stripped from floor to about 1.2 m around the whole room
all lower cabinets gone; upper cabinets intact

cues: uniform horizontal cut line is typical of flood remediation, not a single pipe leak
remediation already done, so earlier mould cannot be assessed

post_mitigation_photo.detail: photo was taken after the demolition/strip-out, not at the time of the loss

regional_indicators: timber stud walls and US electrical boxes, uncommon in NL

summary.en: Kitchen stripped to the studs up to about 1.2 m all round, with all base units removed. The even line suggests rising floodwater rather than a pipe leak. The photo was taken after cleanup, not at the time of the loss.
summary.nl: Keuken tot circa 1,2 m gestript tot op het regelwerk, onderkasten verwijderd. De gelijkmatige lijn wijst op overstroming, niet op een leidinglek. Foto na sanering genomen.

warnings.message: Even damage height around the room suggests outside floodwater, which may be excluded.
Original damage state not visible; extent must be verified from other evidence.

room_type_cues: glazed ceramic wall tiles up to the ceiling
suspended acoustic ceiling tiles (more typical of commercial washrooms)

damage_types.location: small dark cluster in the stain centre

cues: several concentric tide rings suggest repeated wetting

regional_indicators: drop ceiling in a tiled room is atypical for NL homes

summary.en: One suspended ceiling tile in a fully tiled room, probably a bathroom, with a brown water stain showing several tide rings. The repeated rings point to recurring rather than one-off leaking.
summary.nl: Eén systeemplafondplaat in een betegelde ruimte (waarschijnlijk badkamer) met een bruine watervlek en meerdere randen. Wijst op herhaalde lekkage.

warnings.message: Multiple tide rings indicate recurring leakage.

room_type_cues: sealant line along a shower tray or tile edge

peril_indicated.note: Mould growth, not a peril by itself

damage_types.location: band along the bottom of the textured wall above the sealant

damaged_parts.part: wall finish above the shower edge

cues: mature mould colonies take weeks to months to form

summary.en: Close-up of black mould along the bottom of a shower wall above the sealant. This is a classic sign of long-term moisture and poor ventilation, not a sudden event.
summary.nl: Close-up van zwarte schimmel onderaan een douchewand boven de kitlijn. Klassiek teken van langdurig vocht, geen plotselinge gebeurtenis.

warnings.message: Mould growth indicates gradual damage, typically excluded.

room_type_cues: wall-hung oak-effect cabinet
possibly a fridge top at the lower left

damage_types.location: brown rings around the mould patches
ceiling board fallen away along a joist
exposed joist/beam is dark and decayed

regional_indicators: popcorn ceiling is typical of US homes

summary.en: Ceiling in what looks like a kitchen, heavily covered in black mould, with tide rings and a partial collapse exposing a rotted beam. This is long-term water ingress, which contradicts a story of one sudden event.
summary.nl: Plafond (waarschijnlijk keuken) zwaar aangetast door zwarte schimmel, met vochtranden en gedeeltelijke instorting waarbij een verrotte balk zichtbaar is. Langdurige waterinslag; past niet bij één plotselinge gebeurtenis.

warnings.message: Mould, tide marks and rot indicate long-term leakage or lack of maintenance.

room_type_cues: stone steps bottom-left
two-tone utility paint
surface-run pipes and cables

damage_types.location: from a wall penetration down to the floor
around a copper pipe and cables entering the wall

summary.en: Utility or stairwell wall with a long rust-coloured streak running down from a corroded pipe and cable entry, plus salt deposits and peeling paint. This is long-term seepage, not a fresh burst.
summary.nl: Wand in trapgat/kelder met een lange roestkleurige streep vanaf een gecorrodeerde leidingdoorvoer, zoutuitbloei en afbladderende verf. Langdurige lekkage, geen recente breuk.

warnings.message: Corrosion and efflorescence indicate gradual leakage.

room_type_cues: wall socket next to a door frame

damage_types.location: lower receptacle of a duplex socket
bottom edge of the cover plate

severity.note: Fire damage is confined to the socket

cues: fresh charring, clean wall around it

open_fire_evident.note: The charring is consistent with a small electrical fire, but it could also be scorching without open flame

regional_indicators: North American NEMA 5-15 socket; not used in NL

summary.en: Wall socket whose lower outlet is burned and melted, with a little soot on the cover plate. Consistent with a small electrical fire. The wall around it looks undamaged.
summary.nl: Wandcontactdoos waarvan de onderste aansluiting is verbrand en gesmolten, lichte roet op de afdekplaat. Past bij een kleine elektrische brand; omliggende wand oogt onbeschadigd.

warnings.message: North American socket type. Demo images are internationally sourced, so this should not count as a risk signal in the demo config.
Policy distinguishes fire (covered) from scorching/melting without flame (excluded).

room_type_cues: street view of a red-brick semi-detached house

damage_types.location: most of the main roof; charred rafters exposed

damaged_parts.part: brick facade and front bay windows

cues: safety cordon tape and traffic cones

visible_text: partial UK number plate on a parked car
regional_indicators: UK street sign and number plate

summary.en: Red-brick semi-detached house whose roof has largely burned away, leaving charred rafters, with one burned-out upper window. The walls are standing and a safety cordon is in place. Severe, recent fire damage.
summary.nl: Rode bakstenen twee-onder-een-kapwoning waarvan het dak grotendeels is uitgebrand (verkoolde spanten) en één bovenraam is uitgebrand. Gevels staan nog, afzetlint aanwezig. Zware, recente brandschade.

warnings.message: Readable street name and UK plate; compare with insured address.

room_type_cues: tiled masonry heater/stove typical of a living area
photo taken through a doorway opening

damage_types.location: whole room; charred log walls and collapsed beams

cues: debris could have lain for some time, which cannot be dated

regional_indicators: Nordic/Baltic log construction with tiled stove; atypical for NL

summary.en: Room completely burned out: charred timber walls, collapsed beams and ash and debris on the floor, with a tiled stove still standing and blackened by soot. Severe, effectively a total loss of the room.
summary.nl: Volledig uitgebrande ruimte: verkoolde houten wanden, ingestorte balken, as en puin op de vloer; tegelkachel staat nog, zwart van roet. Zware schade, feitelijk totaal verlies van de ruimte.

warnings.message: Log-wall construction is unusual for the insured region.

room_type_cues: two-storey brick block of flats seen from the street

damage_types.location: around the collapsed chimney and scattered

cues: temporary barriers and sheeting on the wall

summary.en: Two-storey block of flats where the chimney has collapsed onto the roof, scattering bricks and breaking tiles. Temporary barriers are in place. Fresh storm damage.
summary.nl: Portiekflat van twee verdiepingen waar de schoorsteen op het dak is ingestort; stenen en gebroken pannen liggen verspreid, hekwerk geplaatst. Verse stormschade.

warnings.message: Readable street name; compare with insured address.
Perceptual hash of this image is registered on a past claim (see history.json) - duplicate photo.

room_type_cues: gable end and roof of a brick house

damage_types.location: chimney stack toppled across the roof
flexible steel flue lying on the roof

damaged_parts.condition: broken under the debris, roughly 4-8 m2

cues: fresh, clean break faces on the bricks
debris still lying on the roof

summary.en: Close-up of a chimney that has toppled across a tiled roof, with broken tiles, an exposed flue liner and a bent TV aerial. Fresh storm damage on one section of the roof.
summary.nl: Close-up van een omgewaaide schoorsteen op een pannendak, met gebroken pannen, losgetrokken rookgaskanaal en verbogen antenne. Verse, lokale stormschade.

warnings.message: Same building as IMG-13; if both are submitted on different claims, that is a duplicate signal.

room_type_cues: roof section seen from outside; sky visible through the battens

damage_types.location: large hole in the middle of the roof slope

damaged_parts.condition: missing over about 6-10 m2, others broken or slipped
exposed, grey weathered wood, one sagging

cues: the gap could be from wind
battens are grey and weathered with no fresh break faces, and tiles carry lichen, which suggests an old opening or lack of maintenance

summary.en: Old clay-pantile roof with a large section of tiles missing and the battens open to the sky. Wind could have done this, but the grey, weathered battens and lichen also fit an opening that has existed for a long time or poor maintenance.
summary.nl: Oud pannendak waarvan een groot deel van de pannen ontbreekt; de panlatten liggen open. Kan stormschade zijn, maar de grijze verweerde latten en het korstmos passen ook bij een al langer bestaande opening of achterstallig onderhoud.

warnings.message: Weathering suggests the opening may predate the reported storm.

room_type_cues: single-storey house with siding, viewed from the garden

issues: foreground branches partly obscure the view

damage_types.location: uprooted tree resting on roof and front wall

summary.en: A large uprooted tree has fallen onto a single-storey house, crushing part of the roof, breaking the eaves and gutter, and smashing a window. Severe, sudden storm damage.
summary.nl: Een grote ontwortelde boom is op een woning van één bouwlaag gevallen: dak deels ingedrukt, dakgoot en boeiboord gebroken, raam vernield. Zware, plotselinge stormschade.

room_type_cues: front garden between two houses, driveway and garage

damage_present.note: Tree is down but no damage to a building is visible

severity.note: Severity refers to insured buildings; the garden itself is disturbed

cues: fresh soil at the root plate
rot visible inside the broken trunk base could mean the tree was already weakened

summary.en: A large tree has been uprooted and lies across the front garden. It missed the house, garage and car, and no damage to the buildings is visible.
summary.nl: Een grote boom is ontworteld en ligt in de voortuin; woning, garage en auto zijn gemist. Geen schade aan opstallen zichtbaar.

warnings.message: Tree removal is only covered when the tree damaged an insured building.

room_type_cues: rendered wall with a window, viewed from outside

damage_types.location: upper-left pane: small hole with radial and concentric cracks

damaged_parts.part: window glass (one pane, likely double glazing)
damaged_parts.condition: cracked from a single impact, still in the frame

summary.en: A window pane in a rendered wall with a single impact point and spider-web cracks, typical of a thrown or kicked object such as a ball or stone. The frame is undamaged.
summary.nl: Ruit in een gestuukte gevel met één inslagpunt en spinnenwebscheuren, typisch voor een bal of steen. Kozijn onbeschadigd.

room_type_cues: interior painted door and frame

damage_types.location: door jamb at the bolt keeper

damaged_parts.condition: split lengthwise, wood splintered, keeper torn out
intact, still in the locked position

cues: fresh, bright wood at the split

summary.en: Door secured with a barrel bolt has been forced: the frame is split lengthwise and freshly splintered where the keeper was torn out. Clear signs of forced entry.
summary.nl: Een met schuifgrendel afgesloten deur is opengebroken: het kozijn is in de lengte gespleten en vers versplinterd waar de sluitplaat is uitgerukt. Duidelijke braaksporen.

room_type_cues: sofa, table lamp, side table, coffee table, curtains

damaged_parts.condition: a few small marks on the right wall, not indicative of damage

summary.en: A lived-in living room with a green sofa, lamp, curtains and wooden floor. No visible damage.
summary.nl: Een bewoonde woonkamer met groene bank, lamp, gordijnen en houten vloer. Geen zichtbare schade.

warnings.message: Image shows no damage; ask the customer for a photo of the damage.
